data.title: Police summons as witness – interview on 2 June 2025
data.summary: The Polizeipräsidium Beispielfurt (Kriminalinspektion 21) summons Elias Beispielhofer as a witness in an investigation into criminal damage to vehicles in the Uferweg underground car park on 21 April 2025, requesting him to appear for an interview on 2 June 2025 at 09:15 at the police station.
data.explanation: This is a formal request (Vorladung) from the police asking you to appear as a witness, not as a suspect, regarding damaged vehicles in your building's garage. Bring your ID card or passport and this letter to the interview. If the date doesn't work, call the given phone extension to arrange another one. As a witness you may also claim compensation for travel costs and lost earnings under the JVEG (a compensation law). Note that this letter and the appointment date are from 2025, so if you are only seeing this now, contact the listed phone number to clarify whether the appointment is still relevant.
